subject: general
question: In which year was the Jnanpith Award given for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1965**__.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

 
• The first recipient of the award was the Malayalam writer G. Sankara Kurup.
 
• He received the award in 1965 for his collection of poems, 'Odakkuzhal (The c)', published in 1950.
 
• Ashapurna
